title: carduus carlinoides subsp. hispanicus
intro: Carduus carlinoides subsp. hispanicus, commonly known as the Spanish plume thistle, is a subspecies of thistle native to the Iberian Peninsula. As a medicinal plant, it has been traditionally used to treat various ailments due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Carduus carlinoides subsp. hispanicus include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote digestive health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
